defmodule Dhc.Destinations do
  @moduledoc """
  Domain-neutral rules for a workshop destination (ALE-438/ALE-440).

  A destination is the optional detail a short venue label alone cannot give an
  attendee: a recognizable name and address for the same place, plus an
  optional manually supplied Google Maps link used for directions. The label
  stays required and independent in every source context; a destination never
  replaces it.

  This module owns the two rules every workshop-owning context shares:

    * which manually supplied URLs are supported HTTPS Maps destinations, and
    * how a destination composes the recognizable Calendar location string,
      falling back to the source's own label when no destination is stored.

  It is deliberately free of workshop policy: storage, commands and scheduling
  stay with each source context (ADR 0029), and no provider response shape or
  provider identity lives here — a Google-selected destination (later work)
  will reuse these seams without either context importing the other.

  ## URL scope

  Only `https` links on Google's Maps surfaces are accepted: executable and
  non-secure schemes, embedded credentials, explicit ports, and hosts or paths
  outside Maps are refused. The check is a safety allowlist, not an attempt to
  prove the link resolves to a particular place; a name/address remains useful
  without a link, and a link without a provider listing is a valid destination.
  """

  @name_max 255
  @address_max 500
  @url_max 2048

  # `google.com` hosts serve Maps under a `/maps` path prefix; the dedicated
  # `maps.google.com` host is Maps-only, so any path is a Maps destination.
  @google_maps_path_hosts ~w(www.google.com google.com)
  @google_hosts ~w(maps.google.com)
  # Short-link hosts exist only for Maps, so any path is a Maps destination.
  @short_link_hosts ~w(maps.app.goo.gl)

  # Hosts whose links are Maps only when the path says so.
  @short_link_maps_path_hosts ~w(goo.gl g.co)

  @type url_error ::
          :invalid_url | :unsupported_scheme | :credentials | :unsupported_target

  @doc """
  The maximum length of a destination name.
  """
  @spec name_max() :: pos_integer()
  def name_max, do: @name_max

  @doc """
  The maximum length of a destination address.
  """
  @spec address_max() :: pos_integer()
  def address_max, do: @address_max

  @doc """
  The maximum length of a manually supplied directions link.
  """
  @spec url_max() :: pos_integer()
  def url_max, do: @url_max

  @doc """
  Trims optional destination text, treating an empty string as absent.

  Both source contexts normalize destination input through this so an emptied
  form field clears the stored detail instead of persisting whitespace.
  """
  @spec normalize_optional(String.t() | nil) :: String.t() | nil
  def normalize_optional(nil), do: nil

  def normalize_optional(text) when is_binary(text) do
    case String.trim(text) do
      "" -> nil
      trimmed -> trimmed
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Whether a manually supplied directions link is a supported HTTPS Maps
  destination.

  `nil` (no link) is always allowed: the link is optional. Every refusal is a
  named reason from the closed `t:url_error/0` set.
  """
  @spec validate_maps_url(String.t() | nil) :: :ok | {:error, url_error()}
  def validate_maps_url(nil), do: :ok

  def validate_maps_url(url) when is_binary(url) do
    with :ok <- check_length(url),
         {:ok, uri} <- parse(url),
         :ok <- check_scheme(uri),
         :ok <- check_credentials(uri),
         :ok <- check_target(uri) do
      :ok
    end
  end

  def validate_maps_url(_other), do: {:error, :invalid_url}

  @doc """
  The one user-facing sentence for each `validate_maps_url/1` refusal.

  Source contexts render this as the field message on their own directions-link
  field, so both contexts word the same refusal the same way.
  """
  @spec url_error_message(url_error()) :: String.t()
  def url_error_message(:invalid_url), do: "Directions link must be a valid URL"
  def url_error_message(:unsupported_scheme), do: "Directions link must be an https link"

  def url_error_message(:credentials),
    do: "Directions link must not include a username or password"

  def url_error_message(:unsupported_target),
    do: "Directions link must be a Google Maps link"

  @doc """
  Composes the Calendar location string from a destination's name and address,
  falling back to the source's own venue label when neither is stored.

  The result is recognizable free-form text for Google's native event location
  field — never a link, and never a fabricated place for an unreviewed label.
  A destination with only a link keeps the label, because a URL is not a
  location people can read.
  """
  @spec calendar_location(String.t() | nil, String.t() | nil, String.t() | nil) ::
          String.t()
  def calendar_location(name, address, label) do
    composed =
      [name, address]
      |> Enum.map(&normalize_optional/1)
      |> Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)
      |> Enum.join(", ")

    if composed == "", do: normalize_optional(label) || "", else: composed
  end

  # ── URL checks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  defp check_length(url) do
    if String.length(url) <= @url_max,
      do: :ok,
      else: {:error, :invalid_url}
  end

  defp parse(url) do
    case URI.new(url) do
      {:ok, %URI{} = uri} -> {:ok, uri}
      {:error, _part} -> {:error, :invalid_url}
    end
  end

  defp check_scheme(%URI{scheme: scheme}) do
    if scheme != nil and String.downcase(scheme) == "https",
      do: :ok,
      else: {:error, :unsupported_scheme}
  end

  defp check_credentials(%URI{userinfo: nil}), do: :ok
  defp check_credentials(%URI{}), do: {:error, :credentials}

  # `URI.new/1` fills in the scheme's default port (443 for https), so only a
  # non-default explicit port is refused; no Maps share link carries one.
  defp check_target(%URI{port: port}) when is_integer(port) and port != 443,
    do: {:error, :unsupported_target}

  defp check_target(%URI{host: host, path: path}) when is_binary(host) do
    host = host |> String.downcase() |> String.trim_trailing(".")

    cond do
      host in @google_maps_path_hosts -> maps_path?(path)
      host in @google_hosts -> :ok
      host in @short_link_hosts -> :ok
      host in @short_link_maps_path_hosts -> maps_path?(path)
      true -> {:error, :unsupported_target}
    end
  end

  defp check_target(_uri), do: {:error, :invalid_url}

  defp maps_path?(path) do
    if path in ["/maps", "/maps/"] or String.starts_with?(path || "", "/maps/"),
      do: :ok,
      else: {:error, :unsupported_target}
  end
end

  end

  defp update_workshop_attendance_locked(workshop_id, marked_by, updates) do
    with :ok <- ensure_attendance_updates_present(updates),
         %Workshop{} = workshop <-
           Repo.one(from(w in Workshop, where: w.id == ^workshop_id, lock: "FOR UPDATE")),
         :ok <- ensure_workshop_started(workshop),
         :ok <- ensure_unique_attendance_registration_ids(updates),
         {:ok, registrations} <- active_attendance_registrations(workshop_id, updates) do
      persist_attendance_updates(updates, registrations, marked_by)
    else
      nil -> Repo.rollback(:not_found)
      {:error, reason} -> Repo.rollback(reason)
    end
  end

  defp persist_attendance_updates(updates, registrations, marked_by) do
    now = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)

    Enum.map(updates, fn update ->
      registration = Map.fetch!(registrations, update.registration_id)

      registration
      |> Ecto.Changeset.change(%{
        attendance_status: update.attendance_status,
        attendance_notes: update.notes,
        attendance_marked_at: now,
        attendance_marked_by: marked_by
      })
      |> Repo.update!()
    end)
  end

  # ── Management lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  @doc """
  Creates a planned Workshop management row.

  `created_by` is always taken from the authenticated coordinator/admin user id,
  never from client input. Status starts as `planned`; lifecycle transitions use
  `publish_workshop/1` and `cancel_workshop/1`.
  """
  @spec create_workshop(map(), binary()) :: {:ok, Workshop.t()} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()}
  def create_workshop(attrs, created_by) when is_map(attrs) and is_binary(created_by) do
    Repo.transaction(fn ->
      with {:ok, workshop} <-
             %Workshop{created_by: created_by, status: "planned"}
             |> Workshop.management_changeset(attrs)
             |> Repo.insert(),
           :ok <- WorkshopCalendar.record_change(:workshop, workshop.id) do
        workshop
      else
        {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} -> Repo.rollback(changeset)
      end
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates Workshop management fields.

  General edits are planned-only. Pricing-only edits preserve the existing
  looser rule approved in ALE-118: pricing may also be changed after publish as
  long as there are zero active (`pending`/`confirmed`) registrations.
  """
  @spec update_workshop(binary(), map()) ::
          {:ok, Workshop.t()}
          | {:error, :not_found | :not_editable | :pricing_locked | Ecto.Changeset.t()}
  def update_workshop(workshop_id, attrs) when is_binary(workshop_id) and is_map(attrs) do
    Repo.transaction(fn ->
      with %Workshop{} = workshop <-
             Repo.one(from(w in Workshop, where: w.id == ^workshop_id, lock: "FOR UPDATE")),
           :ok <- authorize_update(workshop, attrs),
           {:ok, updated} <- workshop |> Workshop.management_changeset(attrs) |> Repo.update(),
           :ok <- WorkshopCalendar.record_change(:workshop, updated.id) do
        updated
      else
        nil -> Repo.rollback(:not_found)
        {:error, reason} -> Repo.rollback(reason)
      end
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Deletes or archives a Workshop.

  ALE-181 rewrite. The gate is registrations-existence, not status: a Workshop
  with any registration history is soft-deleted (archived) so its financial and
  audit rows are retained permanently (the financial-tail FKs are RESTRICT); a
  Workshop with no registrations is hard-deleted. The previous status gate
  (`planned`-only) is dropped.

  ## Returns

    * `{:ok, :archived, workshop}` — the Workshop had registrations and was
      soft-deleted (`archived_at` set). The controller returns `200` with the
      archived Workshop summary body.

    if summary, do: with_capacity_projection(summary)
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the narrow Workshop source projection used by the committee Calendar
  integration, or `nil` when the Workshop no longer exists.

  Archived Workshops intentionally remain a Calendar source: archival hides a
  Workshop from dashboard reads, but does not alter its committee Calendar
  event. The projection deliberately excludes descriptions, notes, capacity,
  pricing, and attendee data.

  ALE-440: `location` is the recognizable Calendar location string — the
  manually entered destination name/address when one is stored, else the short
  venue label. It is never a link.
  """
  @spec calendar_projection(binary()) ::
          %{
            id: binary(),
            title: String.t(),
            status: String.t(),
            start_date: DateTime.t(),
            end_date: DateTime.t(),
            location: String.t()
          }
          | nil
  def calendar_projection(workshop_id) when is_binary(workshop_id) do
    from(w in Workshop,
      where: w.id == ^workshop_id,
      select: %{
        id: w.id,
        title: w.title,
        status: w.status,
        start_date: w.start_date,
        end_date: w.end_date,
        label: w.location,
        destination_name: w.destination_name,
        destination_address: w.destination_address
      }
    )
    |> Repo.one()
    |> case do
      nil ->
        nil

      source ->
        calendar_source(source)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Returns Workshop ids a Calendar repair pass must reconcile.

  Upcoming Workshops remain sources after archival. Cancelled Workshops are
  included regardless of date so a delayed repair can still cancel a Calendar
  event after its source has passed.
  """
  @spec calendar_source_ids(DateTime.t()) :: [binary()]
  def calendar_source_ids(%DateTime{} = now) do
    from(w in Workshop,
      where: w.end_date > ^now or w.status == "cancelled",
      select: w.id
    )
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  @doc "Closed projections for the upcoming sources selected during Calendar launch."
  @spec calendar_launch_sources(DateTime.t()) :: [map()]
  def calendar_launch_sources(%DateTime{} = now) do
    from(w in Workshop,
      where: w.status != "cancelled" and w.start_date > ^now,
      order_by: [asc: w.start_date, asc: w.id],
      select: %{
        id: w.id,
        title: w.title,
        status: w.status,
        start_date: w.start_date,
        end_date: w.end_date,
        label: w.location,
        destination_name: w.destination_name,
        destination_address: w.destination_address
      }
    )
    |> Repo.all()
    |> Enum.map(&calendar_source/1)
  end

  # Keep the Calendar projection closed. The intermediate fields are selected only
  # to derive the native location and must never escape to the shared protocol.
  defp calendar_source(source) do
    %{
      id: source.id,
      title: source.title,
      status: source.status,
      start_date: source.start_date,
      end_date: source.end_date,
      location:
        Destinations.calendar_location(
          source.destination_name,
          source.destination_address,
          source.label
        )
    }
  end

  @spec calendar_launch_places(binary()) :: [%{place_id: binary(), recipient: String.t() | nil}]

defmodule Dhc.Workshops.Workshop do
  @moduledoc """
  Read-only Ecto schema for the `club_activities` table.

  Maps the **persistence** vocabulary for Workshops. `club_activities` /
  `club_activity*` are storage names only; the public/domain names exposed by
  `Dhc.Workshops` read-model helpers use Workshop language (Workshop, interest,
  registration, attendee, refund). Keep this schema internal — do not return
  it directly from a controller; build a domain-shaped DTO in the context
  instead.

  The table is created by the baseline Ecto migration
  `20260512000007_create_club_activities` and owned by the application. Its
  `status` column is the Postgres `club_activity_status` enum, declared here as
  `:string` (Postgres implicitly casts enum ↔ text at the column boundary, so
  no custom Ecto type is needed — same pattern as `WaitlistEntry.status`).
  """

  use Ecto.Schema

  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias Dhc.Destinations

  @primary_key {:id, :binary_id, autogenerate: true}
  @foreign_key_type :binary_id
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  schema "club_activities" do
    field :title, :string
    field :description, :string
    field :location, :string
    # ALE-440: optional, manually entered destination details. The short
    # venue label (`location`) stays required and independent; these are all
    # nullable so legacy rows and label-only submissions remain valid.
    field :destination_name, :string
    field :destination_address, :string
    field :directions_url, :string
    field :start_date, :utc_datetime
    field :end_date, :utc_datetime
    field :max_capacity, :integer
    field :price_member, :float
    field :price_non_member, :float
    field :is_public, :boolean, default: false
    field :refund_days, :integer, default: 3
    field :status, :string, default: "planned"
    field :announce_discord, :boolean, default: false
    field :announce_email, :boolean, default: false
    # `created_by` references `auth.users(id)` (Supabase-owned); read-only here.
    field :created_by, :binary_id
    # ALE-181: soft-delete marker. `nil` = active; a timestamp = archived.
    # `summary_query/0` filters `archived_at IS NULL` so archived Workshops
    # drop out of summaries without losing their financial/audit rows.
    field :archived_at, :utc_datetime

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime, inserted_at: :created_at)
  end

  @management_fields ~w(title description location destination_name destination_address
    directions_url start_date end_date max_capacity price_member price_non_member is_public refund_days announce_discord announce_email)a
  @required_management_fields ~w(title location start_date end_date max_capacity price_member price_non_member is_public refund_days announce_discord announce_email)a

  @doc false
  def management_changeset(workshop, attrs) do
    workshop
    |> cast(attrs, @management_fields)
    |> normalize_destination()
    |> validate_required(@required_management_fields)
    |> validate_length(:title, min: 1, max: 255)
    |> validate_number(:max_capacity, greater_than: 0)
    |> validate_number(:price_member, greater_than_or_equal_to: 0)
    |> validate_number(:price_non_member, greater_than_or_equal_to: 0)
    |> validate_number(:refund_days, greater_than_or_equal_to: 0)
    |> validate_destination()
    |> validate_end_after_start()
  end

  # ALE-440: destination fields are optional free text, so an emptied or
  # whitespace-only submission means "absent", not a stored empty string. The
  # label itself stays required exactly as before.
  defp normalize_destination(changeset) do
    Enum.reduce(
      [:destination_name, :destination_address, :directions_url],
      changeset,
      fn field, acc ->
        case get_change(acc, field) do
          change when is_binary(change) ->
            put_change(acc, field, Destinations.normalize_optional(change))

          _ ->
            acc
        end
      end
    )
  end

  defp validate_destination(changeset) do
    changeset
    |> validate_length(:destination_name, max: Destinations.name_max())
    |> validate_length(:destination_address, max: Destinations.address_max())
    |> validate_directions_url()
  end

  # Only a *supplied* link is judged; clearing it (nil) is a valid edit. The
  # closed reason set and its wording live in `Dhc.Destinations` so the
  # Beginners' Workshop destination work reuses the same rule.
  defp validate_directions_url(changeset) do
    case get_field(changeset, :directions_url) do
      nil ->
        changeset

      url ->
        case Destinations.validate_maps_url(url) do
          :ok ->
            changeset

          {:error, reason} ->
            add_error(changeset, :directions_url, Destinations.url_error_message(reason))
        end
    end
  end

  defp validate_end_after_start(changeset) do
    start_date = get_field(changeset, :start_date)
    end_date = get_field(changeset, :end_date)

    else
      changeset
    end
  end

defmodule Dhc.Destinations do
  @moduledoc """
  Domain-neutral rules for a workshop destination (ALE-438/ALE-440).

  A destination is the optional detail a short venue label alone cannot give an
  attendee: a recognizable name and address for the same place, plus an
  optional manually supplied Google Maps link used for directions. The label
  stays required and independent in every source context; a destination never
  replaces it.

  This module owns the two rules every workshop-owning context shares:

    * which manually supplied URLs are supported HTTPS Maps destinations, and
    * how a destination composes the recognizable Calendar location string,
      falling back to the source's own label when no destination is stored.

  It is deliberately free of workshop policy: storage, commands and scheduling
  stay with each source context (ADR 0029), and no provider response shape or
  provider identity lives here — a Google-selected destination (later work)
  will reuse these seams without either context importing the other.

  ## URL scope

  Only `https` links on Google's Maps surfaces are accepted: executable and
  non-secure schemes, embedded credentials, explicit ports, and hosts or paths
  outside Maps are refused. The check is a safety allowlist, not an attempt to
  prove the link resolves to a particular place; a name/address remains useful
  without a link, and a link without a provider listing is a valid destination.
  """

  @name_max 255
  @address_max 500
  @url_max 2048

  # `google.com` hosts serve Maps under a `/maps` path prefix; the dedicated
  # `maps.google.com` host is Maps-only, so any path is a Maps destination.
  @google_maps_path_hosts ~w(www.google.com google.com)
  @google_hosts ~w(maps.google.com)
  # Short-link hosts exist only for Maps, so any path is a Maps destination.
  @short_link_hosts ~w(maps.app.goo.gl)

  # Hosts whose links are Maps only when the path says so.
  @short_link_maps_path_hosts ~w(goo.gl g.co)

  @type url_error ::
          :invalid_url | :unsupported_scheme | :credentials | :unsupported_target

  @doc """
  The maximum length of a destination name.
  """
  @spec name_max() :: pos_integer()
  def name_max, do: @name_max

  @doc """
  The maximum length of a destination address.
  """
  @spec address_max() :: pos_integer()
  def address_max, do: @address_max

  @doc """
  The maximum length of a manually supplied directions link.
  """
  @spec url_max() :: pos_integer()
  def url_max, do: @url_max

  @doc """
  Trims optional destination text, treating an empty string as absent.

  Both source contexts normalize destination input through this so an emptied
  form field clears the stored detail instead of persisting whitespace.
  """
  @spec normalize_optional(String.t() | nil) :: String.t() | nil
  def normalize_optional(nil), do: nil

  def normalize_optional(text) when is_binary(text) do
    case String.trim(text) do
      "" -> nil
      trimmed -> trimmed
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Whether a manually supplied directions link is a supported HTTPS Maps
  destination.

  `nil` (no link) is always allowed: the link is optional. Every refusal is a
  named reason from the closed `t:url_error/0` set.
  """
  @spec validate_maps_url(String.t() | nil) :: :ok | {:error, url_error()}
  def validate_maps_url(nil), do: :ok

  def validate_maps_url(url) when is_binary(url) do
    with :ok <- check_length(url),
         {:ok, uri} <- parse(url),
         :ok <- check_scheme(uri),
         :ok <- check_credentials(uri),
         :ok <- check_target(uri) do
      :ok
    end
  end

  def validate_maps_url(_other), do: {:error, :invalid_url}

  @doc """
  The one user-facing sentence for each `validate_maps_url/1` refusal.

  Source contexts render this as the field message on their own directions-link
  field, so both contexts word the same refusal the same way.
  """
  @spec url_error_message(url_error()) :: String.t()
  def url_error_message(:invalid_url), do: "Directions link must be a valid URL"
  def url_error_message(:unsupported_scheme), do: "Directions link must be an https link"

  def url_error_message(:credentials),
    do: "Directions link must not include a username or password"

  def url_error_message(:unsupported_target),
    do: "Directions link must be a Google Maps link"

  @doc """
  Composes the Calendar location string from a destination's name and address,
  falling back to the source's own venue label when neither is stored.

  The result is recognizable free-form text for Google's native event location
  field — never a link, and never a fabricated place for an unreviewed label.
  A destination with only a link keeps the label, because a URL is not a
  location people can read.
  """
  @spec calendar_location(String.t() | nil, String.t() | nil, String.t() | nil) ::
          String.t()
  def calendar_location(name, address, label) do
    composed =
      [name, address]
      |> Enum.map(&normalize_optional/1)
      |> Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)
      |> Enum.join(", ")

    if composed == "", do: normalize_optional(label) || "", else: composed
  end

  # ── URL checks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  defp check_length(url) do
    if String.length(url) <= @url_max,
      do: :ok,
      else: {:error, :invalid_url}
  end

  defp parse(url) do
    case URI.new(url) do
      {:ok, %URI{} = uri} -> {:ok, uri}
      {:error, _part} -> {:error, :invalid_url}
    end
  end

  defp check_scheme(%URI{scheme: scheme}) do
    if scheme != nil and String.downcase(scheme) == "https",
      do: :ok,
      else: {:error, :unsupported_scheme}
  end

  defp check_credentials(%URI{userinfo: nil}), do: :ok
  defp check_credentials(%URI{}), do: {:error, :credentials}

  # `URI.new/1` fills in the scheme's default port (443 for https), so only a
  # non-default explicit port is refused; no Maps share link carries one.
  defp check_target(%URI{port: port}) when is_integer(port) and port != 443,
    do: {:error, :unsupported_target}

  defp check_target(%URI{host: host, path: path}) when is_binary(host) do
    host = host |> String.downcase() |> String.trim_trailing(".")

    cond do
      host in @google_maps_path_hosts -> maps_path?(path)
      host in @google_hosts -> :ok
      host in @short_link_hosts -> :ok
      host in @short_link_maps_path_hosts -> maps_path?(path)
      true -> {:error, :unsupported_target}
    end
  end

  defp check_target(_uri), do: {:error, :invalid_url}

  defp maps_path?(path) do
    if path in ["/maps", "/maps/"] or String.starts_with?(path || "", "/maps/"),
      do: :ok,
      else: {:error, :unsupported_target}
  end
end

  end

  defp update_workshop_attendance_locked(workshop_id, marked_by, updates) do
    with :ok <- ensure_attendance_updates_present(updates),

  end

  defp persist_attendance_updates(updates, registrations, marked_by) do
    now = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.truncate(:second)

    Enum.map(updates, fn update ->

        attendance_status: update.attendance_status,
        attendance_notes: update.notes,
        attendance_marked_at: now,
        attendance_marked_by: marked_by
      })
      |> Repo.update!()
    end)
  end

  # ── Management lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  @doc """
  Creates a planned Workshop management row.

  `created_by` is always taken from the authenticated coordinator/admin user id,
  never from client input. Status starts as `planned`; lifecycle transitions use
  `publish_workshop/1` and `cancel_workshop/1`.
  """
  @spec create_workshop(map(), binary()) :: {:ok, Workshop.t()} | {:error, Ecto.Changeset.t()}
  def create_workshop(attrs, created_by) when is_map(attrs) and is_binary(created_by) do
    Repo.transaction(fn ->
      with {:ok, workshop} <-
             %Workshop{created_by: created_by, status: "planned"}
             |> Workshop.management_changeset(attrs)
             |> Repo.insert(),
           :ok <- WorkshopCalendar.record_change(:workshop, workshop.id) do
        workshop
      else
        {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{} = changeset} -> Repo.rollback(changeset)
      end
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Updates Workshop management fields.

  General edits are planned-only. Pricing-only edits preserve the existing
  looser rule approved in ALE-118: pricing may also be changed after publish as
  long as there are zero active (`pending`/`confirmed`) registrations.
  """
  @spec update_workshop(binary(), map()) ::
          {:ok, Workshop.t()}
          | {:error, :not_found | :not_editable | :pricing_locked | Ecto.Changeset.t()}
  def update_workshop(workshop_id, attrs) when is_binary(workshop_id) and is_map(attrs) do
    Repo.transaction(fn ->
      with %Workshop{} = workshop <-
             Repo.one(from(w in Workshop, where: w.id == ^workshop_id, lock: "FOR UPDATE")),
           :ok <- authorize_update(workshop, attrs),
           {:ok, updated} <- workshop |> Workshop.management_changeset(attrs) |> Repo.update(),
           :ok <- WorkshopCalendar.record_change(:workshop, updated.id) do
        updated
      else
        nil -> Repo.rollback(:not_found)
        {:error, reason} -> Repo.rollback(reason)
      end
    end)
  end

  @doc """
  Deletes or archives a Workshop.

  ALE-181 rewrite. The gate is registrations-existence, not status: a Workshop
  with any registration history is soft-deleted (archived) so its financial and
  audit rows are retained permanently (the financial-tail FKs are RESTRICT); a
  Workshop with no registrations is hard-deleted. The previous status gate
  (`planned`-only) is dropped.

  ## Returns

    * `{:ok, :archived, workshop}` — the Workshop had registrations and was
      soft-deleted (`archived_at` set). The controller returns `200` with the
      archived Workshop summary body.

    if summary, do: with_capacity_projection(summary)
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the narrow Workshop source projection used by the committee Calendar
  integration, or `nil` when the Workshop no longer exists.

  Archived Workshops intentionally remain a Calendar source: archival hides a
  Workshop from dashboard reads, but does not alter its committee Calendar
  event. The projection deliberately excludes descriptions, notes, capacity,
  pricing, and attendee data.

  ALE-440: `location` is the recognizable Calendar location string — the
  manually entered destination name/address when one is stored, else the short
  venue label. It is never a link.
  """
  @spec calendar_projection(binary()) ::
          %{
            id: binary(),
            title: String.t(),
            status: String.t(),
            start_date: DateTime.t(),
            end_date: DateTime.t(),
            location: String.t()
          }
          | nil
  def calendar_projection(workshop_id) when is_binary(workshop_id) do
    from(w in Workshop,
      where: w.id == ^workshop_id,
      select: %{
        id: w.id,
        title: w.title,
        status: w.status,
        start_date: w.start_date,
        end_date: w.end_date,
        label: w.location,
        destination_name: w.destination_name,
        destination_address: w.destination_address
      }
    )
    |> Repo.one()
    |> case do
      nil ->
        nil

      source ->
        calendar_source(source)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Returns Workshop ids a Calendar repair pass must reconcile.

  Upcoming Workshops remain sources after archival. Cancelled Workshops are
  included regardless of date so a delayed repair can still cancel a Calendar
  event after its source has passed.
  """
  @spec calendar_source_ids(DateTime.t()) :: [binary()]
  def calendar_source_ids(%DateTime{} = now) do
    from(w in Workshop,

  def calendar_launch_sources(%DateTime{} = now) do
    from(w in Workshop,

        destination_name: w.destination_name,
        destination_address: w.destination_address
      }

defmodule Dhc.Workshops.Workshop do
  @moduledoc """
  Read-only Ecto schema for the `club_activities` table.

  Maps the **persistence** vocabulary for Workshops. `club_activities` /
  `club_activity*` are storage names only; the public/domain names exposed by
  `Dhc.Workshops` read-model helpers use Workshop language (Workshop, interest,
  registration, attendee, refund). Keep this schema internal — do not return
  it directly from a controller; build a domain-shaped DTO in the context
  instead.

  The table is created by the baseline Ecto migration
  `20260512000007_create_club_activities` and owned by the application. Its
  `status` column is the Postgres `club_activity_status` enum, declared here as
  `:string` (Postgres implicitly casts enum ↔ text at the column boundary, so
  no custom Ecto type is needed — same pattern as `WaitlistEntry.status`).
  """

  use Ecto.Schema

  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias Dhc.Destinations

  @primary_key {:id, :binary_id, autogenerate: true}
  @foreign_key_type :binary_id
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  schema "club_activities" do
    field :title, :string
    field :description, :string
    field :location, :string
    # ALE-440: optional, manually entered destination details. The short
    # venue label (`location`) stays required and independent; these are all
    # nullable so legacy rows and label-only submissions remain valid.
    field :destination_name, :string
    field :destination_address, :string
    field :directions_url, :string
    field :start_date, :utc_datetime
    field :end_date, :utc_datetime
    field :max_capacity, :integer
    field :price_member, :float
    field :price_non_member, :float
    field :is_public, :boolean, default: false
    field :refund_days, :integer, default: 3
    field :status, :string, default: "planned"
    field :announce_discord, :boolean, default: false
    field :announce_email, :boolean, default: false
    # `created_by` references `auth.users(id)` (Supabase-owned); read-only here.
    field :created_by, :binary_id
    # ALE-181: soft-delete marker. `nil` = active; a timestamp = archived.
    # `summary_query/0` filters `archived_at IS NULL` so archived Workshops
    # drop out of summaries without losing their financial/audit rows.
    field :archived_at, :utc_datetime

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime, inserted_at: :created_at)
  end

  @management_fields ~w(title description location destination_name destination_address
    directions_url start_date end_date max_capacity price_member price_non_member is_public refund_days announce_discord announce_email)a
  @required_management_fields ~w(title location start_date end_date max_capacity price_member price_non_member is_public refund_days announce_discord announce_email)a

  @doc false
  def management_changeset(workshop, attrs) do
    workshop
    |> cast(attrs, @management_fields)
    |> normalize_destination()
    |> validate_required(@required_management_fields)
    |> validate_length(:title, min: 1, max: 255)
    |> validate_number(:max_capacity, greater_than: 0)
    |> validate_number(:price_member, greater_than_or_equal_to: 0)
    |> validate_number(:price_non_member, greater_than_or_equal_to: 0)
    |> validate_number(:refund_days, greater_than_or_equal_to: 0)
    |> validate_destination()
    |> validate_end_after_start()
  end

  # ALE-440: destination fields are optional free text, so an emptied or
  # whitespace-only submission means "absent", not a stored empty string. The
  # label itself stays required exactly as before.
  defp normalize_destination(changeset) do
    Enum.reduce(
      [:destination_name, :destination_address, :directions_url],
      changeset,
      fn field, acc ->
        case get_change(acc, field) do
          change when is_binary(change) ->
            put_change(acc, field, Destinations.normalize_optional(change))

          _ ->
            acc
        end
      end
    )
  end

  defp validate_destination(changeset) do
    changeset
    |> validate_length(:destination_name, max: Destinations.name_max())
    |> validate_length(:destination_address, max: Destinations.address_max())
    |> validate_directions_url()
  end

  # Only a *supplied* link is judged; clearing it (nil) is a valid edit. The
  # closed reason set and its wording live in `Dhc.Destinations` so the
  # Beginners' Workshop destination work reuses the same rule.
  defp validate_directions_url(changeset) do
    case get_field(changeset, :directions_url) do
      nil ->
        changeset

      url ->
        case Destinations.validate_maps_url(url) do
          :ok ->
            changeset

          {:error, reason} ->
            add_error(changeset, :directions_url, Destinations.url_error_message(reason))
        end
    end
  end

  defp validate_end_after_start(changeset) do
    start_date = get_field(changeset, :start_date)
    end_date = get_field(changeset, :end_date)

    if start_date && end_date && DateTime.compare(end_date, start_date) != :gt do
      add_error(changeset, :end_date, "must be after start date")
    else
      changeset
    end
  end
end

defmodule DhcWeb.WorkshopsController do
  use DhcWeb, :controller

  alias Dhc.Workshops

  action_fallback DhcWeb.WorkshopsHTTP

  @moduledoc """
  Workshop management reads.

  `calendar/2` and `attendees/2` are protected by the `:workshops_manage`
  pipeline (the `workshops.manage` capability). `list/2` is
  authenticated-only.

  See `Dhc.Workshops` for the historical `beginners_coordinator`
  registration-visibility drift that the coordinator endpoints deliberately
  do not reproduce.
  """

  @doc """
  GET /workshops/calendar

  Returns non-cancelled Workshops for the coordinator management calendar,
  with interest, active Registration counts, and capacity projections.

  The DTO carries no current-user registration or interest state; those were
  PostgREST join artifacts (PRD #142). Month/date-window pagination is out of
  scope, so the full non-cancelled set is returned.
  """
  def calendar(conn, _params) do
    workshops = Workshops.list_workshop_summaries(exclude_statuses: ~w(cancelled))

    conn
    |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
    |> render(:calendar, workshops: workshops)
  end

  @doc """
  GET /workshops

  Returns the member-safe Workshop collection. Status is constrained to
  `planned` and `published`, and each Workshop includes the current user's
  interest and registration state.
  """
  def list(conn, params) do
    workshops = Workshops.list_member_workshops(conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id, params)

    conn
    |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
    |> render(:list, workshops: workshops)
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops

  Creates a planned Workshop. Coordinator/admin-only via router pipeline.
  """
  def create(conn, params) do
    params
    |> management_attrs()
    |> Workshops.create_workshop(conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id)
    |> case do
      {:ok, workshop} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:created)
        |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
        |> render(:management, workshop: Workshops.workshop_summary(workshop.id))

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  @doc """
  GET /workshops/{id}

  Returns a management Workshop summary for coordinators/admins.
  """
  def show(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Workshops.workshop_summary(id) do
      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
      workshop -> render_management(conn, workshop)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  PATCH /workshops/{id}

  Updates Workshop management fields. Status/lifecycle fields are deliberately
  ignored; publish/cancel have dedicated command endpoints.
  """
  def update(conn, %{"id" => id} = params) do
    attrs =
      params
      |> Map.delete("id")
      |> management_attrs()

    with {:ok, workshop} <- Workshops.update_workshop(id, attrs) do
      render_management(conn, Workshops.workshop_summary(workshop.id))
    end
  end

  @doc """
  DELETE /workshops/{id}

  ALE-181: registrations-existence gates archive-vs-hard-delete.

    * Workshop with registrations → `200` + archived Workshop body (soft-delete).
    * Workshop with no registrations → `204` (hard-delete).
    * Already-archived Workshop → `409`.
    * Unknown Workshop → `404`.
  """
  def delete(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Workshops.delete_workshop(id) do
      {:ok, :deleted} ->
        send_resp(conn, :no_content, "")

      {:ok, :archived, workshop} ->
        render_management(conn, workshop)

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/publish
  """
  def publish(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    with {:ok, workshop} <- Workshops.publish_workshop(id) do
      render_management(conn, Workshops.workshop_summary(workshop.id))
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/cancel
  """
  def cancel(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    with {:ok, workshop} <-
           Workshops.cancel_workshop(id, conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id) do
      render_management(conn, Workshops.workshop_summary(workshop.id))
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/interest

  Toggles the authenticated member's interest in a planned Workshop.
  """
  def toggle_interest(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    with {:ok, result} <-
           Workshops.toggle_interest(id, conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:interest, result: result)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/registration/payment-intent

  Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent for the authenticated member's Workshop
  registration after duplicate and capacity checks.
  """
  def create_registration_payment_intent(conn, %{"id" => id} = params) do
    with {:ok, result} <-
           Workshops.create_member_payment_intent(
             id,
             conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id,
             params
           ) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:registration_payment_intent, result: result)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/registration/complete

  Completes the authenticated member's registration after Stripe confirms the
  PaymentIntent.
  """
  def complete_registration(conn, %{"id" => id, "paymentIntentId" => payment_intent_id}) do
    with {:ok, registration} <-
           Workshops.complete_member_registration(
             id,
             conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id,
             payment_intent_id
           ) do
      conn
      |> put_status(:created)
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:registration, registration: registration)
    end
  end

  def complete_registration(_conn, _params), do: {:error, :payment_intent_required}

  def external_registration_gate(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    gate =
      case Ecto.UUID.cast(id) do
        {:ok, workshop_id} -> Workshops.external_registration_gate(workshop_id)
        :error -> %{can_register: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND"}
      end

    conn
    |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
    |> render(:external_registration_gate, gate: gate)
  end

  def create_external_checkout_session(conn, %{
        "id" => id,
        "paymentAttemptId" => payment_attempt_id,
        "returnUrl" => return_url
      })
      when is_binary(payment_attempt_id) and is_binary(return_url) do
    with {:ok, workshop_id} <- Ecto.UUID.cast(id),
         {:ok, attempt_id} <- Ecto.UUID.cast(payment_attempt_id),
         {:ok, result} <-
           Workshops.create_external_checkout_session(workshop_id, attempt_id, return_url) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:external_checkout_session, result: result)
    else
      error -> external_registration_error(error)
    end
  end

  def create_external_checkout_session(_conn, _params),
    do: {:error, :checkout_details_required}

  def complete_external_registration(conn, %{
        "id" => id,
        "checkoutSessionId" => checkout_session_id
      })
      when is_binary(checkout_session_id) and byte_size(checkout_session_id) > 0 do
    with {:ok, workshop_id} <- Ecto.UUID.cast(id),
         {:ok, registration} <-
           Workshops.complete_external_registration(workshop_id, checkout_session_id) do
      conn
      |> put_status(:created)
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:registration, registration: registration)
    else
      error -> external_registration_error(error)
    end
  end

  def complete_external_registration(_conn, _params),
    do: {:error, :checkout_session_required}

  @doc """
  DELETE /workshops/{id}/registration

  Cancels the authenticated member's active registration.
  """
  def cancel_registration(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    with {:ok, result} <-
           Workshops.cancel_member_registration(id, conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:registration_cancelled, result: result)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  GET /workshops/{id}/attendees

  Returns the combined coordinator attendee/refund management payload for a
  single Workshop: Workshop summary, active attendees (pending/confirmed),
  and refunds. Returns 404 when no Workshop exists for the given id.
  """
  def attendees(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Workshops.workshop_attendees_and_refunds(id) do
      %{workshop: nil} ->
        {:error, :not_found}

      %{workshop: workshop, attendees: attendees, refunds: refunds} ->
        conn
        |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
        |> render(:attendees, workshop: workshop, attendees: attendees, refunds: refunds)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  GET /workshops/{id}/refunds

  Returns coordinator-visible refund records for one Workshop.
  """
  def refunds(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Workshops.workshop_summary(id) do
      nil ->
        {:error, :not_found}

      _workshop ->
        conn
        |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
        |> render(:refunds, refunds: Workshops.list_workshop_refunds(id))
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/registrations/{registration_id}/refund

  Explicitly refunds an eligible Workshop registration. Coordinator identity is
  derived from the authenticated JWT and recorded on the refund attempt.
  """
  def refund_registration(
        conn,
        %{"id" => workshop_id, "registration_id" => registration_id, "reason" => reason}
      )
      when is_binary(reason) and byte_size(reason) > 0 and byte_size(reason) <= 500 do
    reason = String.trim(reason)

    if reason == "" do
      {:error, :refund_reason_required}
    else
      process_registration_refund(conn, workshop_id, registration_id, reason)
    end
  end

  def refund_registration(_conn, _params), do: {:error, :refund_reason_required}

  defp process_registration_refund(conn, workshop_id, registration_id, reason) do
    # The command returns the `list_workshop_refunds/1` projection, so no
    # second read is needed (ALE-340).
    case Workshops.refund_registration(
           workshop_id,
           registration_id,
           reason,
           conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id
         ) do
      {:ok, refund} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:created)
        |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
        |> render(:refund, refund: refund)

      # A refund request's own `:already_requested` is a 422; the 409
      # reason of that name belongs to Workshop cancellation.
      {:error, :already_requested} ->
        {:error, :refund_already_requested}

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  @doc """
  PATCH /workshops/{id}/attendance

  Atomically records attendance for active Workshop attendees after the Workshop
  start time. The coordinator identity is derived from the authenticated JWT.
  """
  def update_attendance(conn, %{"id" => id, "updates" => updates}) when is_list(updates) do
    with {:ok, updates} <- attendance_updates(updates),
         {:ok, registrations} <-
           Workshops.update_workshop_attendance(
             id,
             conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id,
             updates
           ) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:attendance, registrations: registrations)
    end
  end

  def update_attendance(_conn, _params), do: {:error, :attendance_updates_required}

  defp render_management(conn, workshop) do
    conn
    |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
    |> render(:management, workshop: workshop)
  end

  defp management_attrs(params) do
    # `put_if_present` carries an explicit JSON `null` through, which is how a
    # PATCH distinguishes "clear this optional destination detail" from
    # "leave it alone" (an omitted key). The label stays required.
    %{}
    |> put_if_present(params, "title", :title)
    |> put_if_present(params, "description", :description)
    |> put_if_present(params, "location", :location)
    |> put_if_present(params, "destinationName", :destination_name)
    |> put_if_present(params, "destinationAddress", :destination_address)
    |> put_if_present(params, "directionsUrl", :directions_url)
    |> put_datetime_if_present(params, "startDate", :start_date)
    |> put_datetime_if_present(params, "endDate", :end_date)
    |> put_if_present(params, "maxCapacity", :max_capacity)
    |> put_if_present(params, "priceMember", :price_member)
    |> put_if_present(params, "priceNonMember", :price_non_member)
    |> put_if_present(params, "isPublic", :is_public)
    |> put_if_present(params, "refundDays", :refund_days)
    |> put_if_present(params, "announceDiscord", :announce_discord)
    |> put_if_present(params, "announceEmail", :announce_email)
  end

  defp attendance_updates(updates) do
    updates
    |> Enum.reduce_while({:ok, []}, fn update, {:ok, parsed} ->
      with registration_id when is_binary(registration_id) <- Map.get(update, "registrationId"),
           {:ok, registration_id} <- Ecto.UUID.cast(registration_id),
           attendance_status when attendance_status in ["attended", "noShow", "excused"] <-
             Map.get(update, "attendanceStatus"),
           notes when is_nil(notes) or (is_binary(notes) and byte_size(notes) <= 500) <-
             Map.get(update, "notes") do
        {:cont,
         {:ok,
          [
            %{
              registration_id: registration_id,
              attendance_status: attendance_status_to_persistence(attendance_status),
              notes: notes
            }
            | parsed
          ]}}
      else
        _ -> {:halt, {:error, :invalid_updates}}
      end
    end)
    |> case do
      {:ok, parsed} -> {:ok, Enum.reverse(parsed)}
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp attendance_status_to_persistence("noShow"), do: "no_show"
  defp attendance_status_to_persistence(status), do: status

  pipeline (the `workshops.manage` capability). `list/2` is
  authenticated-only.

  See `Dhc.Workshops` for the historical `beginners_coordinator`
  registration-visibility drift that the coordinator endpoints deliberately
  do not reproduce.
  """

  @doc """
  GET /workshops/calendar

  Returns non-cancelled Workshops for the coordinator management calendar,
  with interest, active Registration counts, and capacity projections.

  The DTO carries no current-user registration or interest state; those were
  PostgREST join artifacts (PRD #142). Month/date-window pagination is out of
  scope, so the full non-cancelled set is returned.
  """
  def calendar(conn, _params) do
    workshops = Workshops.list_workshop_summaries(exclude_statuses: ~w(cancelled))

    conn
    |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
    |> render(:calendar, workshops: workshops)
  end

  @doc """
  GET /workshops

  Returns the member-safe Workshop collection. Status is constrained to
  `planned` and `published`, and each Workshop includes the current user's
  interest and registration state.
  """
  def list(conn, params) do
    workshops = Workshops.list_member_workshops(conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id, params)

    conn
    |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
    |> render(:list, workshops: workshops)
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops

  Creates a planned Workshop. Coordinator/admin-only via router pipeline.
  """
  def create(conn, params) do
    params
    |> management_attrs()
    |> Workshops.create_workshop(conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id)
    |> case do
      {:ok, workshop} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:created)
        |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
        |> render(:management, workshop: Workshops.workshop_summary(workshop.id))

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  @doc """
  GET /workshops/{id}

  Returns a management Workshop summary for coordinators/admins.
  """
  def show(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Workshops.workshop_summary(id) do
      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
      workshop -> render_management(conn, workshop)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  PATCH /workshops/{id}

  Updates Workshop management fields. Status/lifecycle fields are deliberately
  ignored; publish/cancel have dedicated command endpoints.
  """
  def update(conn, %{"id" => id} = params) do
    attrs =
      params
      |> Map.delete("id")
      |> management_attrs()

    with {:ok, workshop} <- Workshops.update_workshop(id, attrs) do
      render_management(conn, Workshops.workshop_summary(workshop.id))
    end
  end

  @doc """
  DELETE /workshops/{id}

  ALE-181: registrations-existence gates archive-vs-hard-delete.

    * Workshop with registrations → `200` + archived Workshop body (soft-delete).
    * Workshop with no registrations → `204` (hard-delete).
    * Already-archived Workshop → `409`.
    * Unknown Workshop → `404`.
  """
  def delete(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Workshops.delete_workshop(id) do
      {:ok, :deleted} ->
        send_resp(conn, :no_content, "")

      {:ok, :archived, workshop} ->
        render_management(conn, workshop)

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/publish
  """
  def publish(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    with {:ok, workshop} <- Workshops.publish_workshop(id) do
      render_management(conn, Workshops.workshop_summary(workshop.id))
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/cancel
  """
  def cancel(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    with {:ok, workshop} <-
           Workshops.cancel_workshop(id, conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id) do
      render_management(conn, Workshops.workshop_summary(workshop.id))
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/interest

  Toggles the authenticated member's interest in a planned Workshop.
  """
  def toggle_interest(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    with {:ok, result} <-
           Workshops.toggle_interest(id, conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:interest, result: result)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/registration/payment-intent

  Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent for the authenticated member's Workshop
  registration after duplicate and capacity checks.
  """
  def create_registration_payment_intent(conn, %{"id" => id} = params) do
    with {:ok, result} <-
           Workshops.create_member_payment_intent(
             id,
             conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id,
             params
           ) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:registration_payment_intent, result: result)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/registration/complete

  Completes the authenticated member's registration after Stripe confirms the
  PaymentIntent.
  """
  def complete_registration(conn, %{"id" => id, "paymentIntentId" => payment_intent_id}) do
    with {:ok, registration} <-
           Workshops.complete_member_registration(
             id,
             conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id,
             payment_intent_id
           ) do
      conn
      |> put_status(:created)
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:registration, registration: registration)
    end
  end

  def complete_registration(_conn, _params), do: {:error, :payment_intent_required}

  def external_registration_gate(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    gate =
      case Ecto.UUID.cast(id) do
        {:ok, workshop_id} -> Workshops.external_registration_gate(workshop_id)
        :error -> %{can_register: false, reason: "NOT_FOUND"}
      end

    conn
    |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
    |> render(:external_registration_gate, gate: gate)
  end

  def create_external_checkout_session(conn, %{
        "id" => id,
        "paymentAttemptId" => payment_attempt_id,
        "returnUrl" => return_url
      })
      when is_binary(payment_attempt_id) and is_binary(return_url) do
    with {:ok, workshop_id} <- Ecto.UUID.cast(id),
         {:ok, attempt_id} <- Ecto.UUID.cast(payment_attempt_id),
         {:ok, result} <-
           Workshops.create_external_checkout_session(workshop_id, attempt_id, return_url) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:external_checkout_session, result: result)
    else
      error -> external_registration_error(error)
    end
  end

  def create_external_checkout_session(_conn, _params),
    do: {:error, :checkout_details_required}

  def complete_external_registration(conn, %{
        "id" => id,
        "checkoutSessionId" => checkout_session_id
      })
      when is_binary(checkout_session_id) and byte_size(checkout_session_id) > 0 do
    with {:ok, workshop_id} <- Ecto.UUID.cast(id),
         {:ok, registration} <-
           Workshops.complete_external_registration(workshop_id, checkout_session_id) do
      conn
      |> put_status(:created)
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:registration, registration: registration)
    else
      error -> external_registration_error(error)
    end
  end

  def complete_external_registration(_conn, _params),
    do: {:error, :checkout_session_required}

  @doc """
  DELETE /workshops/{id}/registration

  Cancels the authenticated member's active registration.
  """
  def cancel_registration(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    with {:ok, result} <-
           Workshops.cancel_member_registration(id, conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:registration_cancelled, result: result)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  GET /workshops/{id}/attendees

  Returns the combined coordinator attendee/refund management payload for a
  single Workshop: Workshop summary, active attendees (pending/confirmed),
  and refunds. Returns 404 when no Workshop exists for the given id.
  """
  def attendees(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Workshops.workshop_attendees_and_refunds(id) do
      %{workshop: nil} ->
        {:error, :not_found}

      %{workshop: workshop, attendees: attendees, refunds: refunds} ->
        conn
        |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
        |> render(:attendees, workshop: workshop, attendees: attendees, refunds: refunds)
    end
  end

  @doc """
  GET /workshops/{id}/refunds

  Returns coordinator-visible refund records for one Workshop.
  """
  def refunds(conn, %{"id" => id}) do
    case Workshops.workshop_summary(id) do
      nil ->
        {:error, :not_found}

      _workshop ->
        conn
        |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
        |> render(:refunds, refunds: Workshops.list_workshop_refunds(id))
    end
  end

  @doc """
  POST /workshops/{id}/registrations/{registration_id}/refund

  Explicitly refunds an eligible Workshop registration. Coordinator identity is
  derived from the authenticated JWT and recorded on the refund attempt.
  """
  def refund_registration(
        conn,
        %{"id" => workshop_id, "registration_id" => registration_id, "reason" => reason}
      )
      when is_binary(reason) and byte_size(reason) > 0 and byte_size(reason) <= 500 do
    reason = String.trim(reason)

    if reason == "" do
      {:error, :refund_reason_required}
    else
      process_registration_refund(conn, workshop_id, registration_id, reason)
    end
  end

  def refund_registration(_conn, _params), do: {:error, :refund_reason_required}

  defp process_registration_refund(conn, workshop_id, registration_id, reason) do
    # The command returns the `list_workshop_refunds/1` projection, so no
    # second read is needed (ALE-340).
    case Workshops.refund_registration(
           workshop_id,
           registration_id,
           reason,
           conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id
         ) do
      {:ok, refund} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:created)
        |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
        |> render(:refund, refund: refund)

      # A refund request's own `:already_requested` is a 422; the 409
      # reason of that name belongs to Workshop cancellation.
      {:error, :already_requested} ->
        {:error, :refund_already_requested}

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  @doc """
  PATCH /workshops/{id}/attendance

  Atomically records attendance for active Workshop attendees after the Workshop
  start time. The coordinator identity is derived from the authenticated JWT.
  """
  def update_attendance(conn, %{"id" => id, "updates" => updates}) when is_list(updates) do
    with {:ok, updates} <- attendance_updates(updates),
         {:ok, registrations} <-
           Workshops.update_workshop_attendance(
             id,
             conn.assigns.current_session.principal.id,
             updates
           ) do
      conn
      |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
      |> render(:attendance, registrations: registrations)
    end
  end

  def update_attendance(_conn, _params), do: {:error, :attendance_updates_required}

  defp render_management(conn, workshop) do
    conn
    |> put_view(json: DhcWeb.WorkshopsJSON)
    |> render(:management, workshop: workshop)
  end

  defp management_attrs(params) do
    # `put_if_present` carries an explicit JSON `null` through, which is how a
    # PATCH distinguishes "clear this optional destination detail" from
    # "leave it alone" (an omitted key). The label stays required.
    %{}
    |> put_if_present(params, "title", :title)
    |> put_if_present(params, "description", :description)
    |> put_if_present(params, "location", :location)
    |> put_if_present(params, "destinationName", :destination_name)
    |> put_if_present(params, "destinationAddress", :destination_address)
    |> put_if_present(params, "directionsUrl", :directions_url)
    |> put_datetime_if_present(params, "startDate", :start_date)
    |> put_datetime_if_present(params, "endDate", :end_date)
    |> put_if_present(params, "maxCapacity", :max_capacity)
    |> put_if_present(params, "priceMember", :price_member)
    |> put_if_present(params, "priceNonMember", :price_non_member)
    |> put_if_present(params, "isPublic", :is_public)
    |> put_if_present(params, "refundDays", :refund_days)
    |> put_if_present(params, "announceDiscord", :announce_discord)
    |> put_if_present(params, "announceEmail", :announce_email)
  end

  defp attendance_updates(updates) do
    updates
    |> Enum.reduce_while({:ok, []}, fn update, {:ok, parsed} ->
      with registration_id when is_binary(registration_id) <- Map.get(update, "registrationId"),
           {:ok, registration_id} <- Ecto.UUID.cast(registration_id),
           attendance_status when attendance_status in ["attended", "noShow", "excused"] <-
             Map.get(update, "attendanceStatus"),
           notes when is_nil(notes) or (is_binary(notes) and byte_size(notes) <= 500) <-
             Map.get(update, "notes") do
        {:cont,
         {:ok,
          [
            %{
              registration_id: registration_id,
              attendance_status: attendance_status_to_persistence(attendance_status),
              notes: notes
            }
            | parsed
          ]}}
      else
        _ -> {:halt, {:error, :invalid_updates}}
      end
    end)
    |> case do
      {:ok, parsed} -> {:ok, Enum.reverse(parsed)}
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp attendance_status_to_persistence("noShow"), do: "no_show"
  defp attendance_status_to_persistence(status), do: status

**Investigating missing participant update behavior**

defmodule Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.Store do
  @moduledoc """
  Durable identity, intent and fenced ownership for organizer events.

  Source transactions lock source rows before this row. Reconciliation never
  locks a source row and never holds a transaction across Google I/O. A lease
  survives a crashed driver; every mutation also uses Google's event identity
  or ETag so an expired owner cannot blindly overwrite a newer provider state.
  """
  import Ecto.Query

  alias Dhc.Repo
  alias Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.{Event, Recipients}
  alias Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.Workers.SyncWorker

  @lease_seconds 120
  @max_attempts 6

  def record(kind, id, deleted) do
    unless Repo.in_transaction?(), do: raise("Calendar intent requires the source transaction")

    ensure(kind, id)

    from(e in Event, where: e.source_kind == ^to_string(kind) and e.source_id == ^id)
    |> Repo.update_all(
      inc: [revision: 1],
      set: [deleted: deleted, removal_completed: false, updated_at: DateTime.utc_now()]
    )

    # A source-owned schedule correction can resolve missing legacy data.
    # Do not re-arm provider/configuration failures on unrelated domain writes.
    from(e in Event,
      where:
        e.source_kind == ^to_string(kind) and e.source_id == ^id and
          e.failure in ["missing_end_time", "invalid_schedule"]
    )
    |> Repo.update_all(set: [failure: nil, attempts: 0, retry_at: nil])

    enqueue(kind, id)
    if find(kind, id, "participant"), do: enqueue_audience(kind, id, "participant")
    :ok
  end

  def ensure(kind, id, audience \\ "committee") do
    now = DateTime.utc_now()

    Repo.insert_all(
      Event,
      [
        %{
          id: Ecto.UUID.generate(),
          source_kind: to_string(kind),
          source_id: id,
          audience: to_string(audience),
          event_id: event_id(kind, id, audience, 0),
          inserted_at: now,
          updated_at: now
        }
      ],
      on_conflict: :nothing,
      conflict_target: [:source_kind, :source_id, :audience]
    )

    :ok
  end

  def enqueue(kind, id, delay \\ 0) do
    %{source_kind: to_string(kind), source_id: id}
    |> SyncWorker.new(schedule_in: delay)
    |> Oban.insert!()
  end

  def enqueue_audience(kind, id, audience, delay \\ 0) do
    %{source_kind: to_string(kind), source_id: id, audience: to_string(audience)}
    |> SyncWorker.new(schedule_in: delay)
    |> Oban.insert!()
  end

  def find(kind, id, audience) do
    Repo.get_by(Event, source_kind: to_string(kind), source_id: id, audience: to_string(audience))
  end

  def claim(kind, id, now, audience \\ "committee") do
    now = timestamp(now)

    {:ok, result} =
      Repo.transaction(fn ->
        event =
          Repo.one!(
            from(e in Event,
              where:
                e.source_kind == ^to_string(kind) and e.source_id == ^id and
                  e.audience == ^to_string(audience),
              lock: "FOR UPDATE"
            )
          )

        claim_available(event, now)
      end)

    result
  end

  defp claim_available(event, now) do
    cond do
      event.removal_completed ->
        {:skip, :removed}

      event.lease_until && DateTime.compare(event.lease_until, now) == :gt ->
        {:skip, :busy}

      event.failure && is_nil(event.retry_at) ->
        {:skip, :failed}

      event.retry_at && DateTime.compare(event.retry_at, now) == :gt ->
        {:skip, :backoff}

      true ->
        claimed =
          persist(event, %{
            lease_token: Ecto.UUID.generate(),
            lease_until: DateTime.add(now, @lease_seconds),
            attempts: event.attempts + 1
          })

        {:ok, claimed}
    end
  end

  def exhausted?(event), do: event.attempts > @max_attempts

  def bind_calendar(event, calendar_id) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      cond do
        is_nil(current.calendar_id) -> {:ok, persist(current, %{calendar_id: calendar_id})}
        current.calendar_id == calendar_id -> {:ok, current}
        true -> {:error, :configuration}
      end
    end)
  end

  # A deleted Google event may remain as a tombstone forever. Persist the new
  # generation before attempting insert, including on the first absent ack.
  def next_generation(event) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      generation = current.generation + 1

      {:ok,
       persist(current, %{
         generation: generation,
         event_id: event_id(current.source_kind, current.source_id, current.audience, generation),
         create_requested: false,
         acknowledged: nil
       })}
    end)
  end

  # Persist the possibility of an ambiguous create before starting HTTP, and
  # refuse a stale lease/revision even if the driver's old source view matches.
  def prepare_create(event) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      if current.revision == event.revision and not current.deleted do
        persist(current, %{create_requested: true})
        :ok
      else
        {:skip, :changed}
      end
    end)
  end

  def finish(event, acknowledged, _now, opts \\ []) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      stale? = current.revision != event.revision or Keyword.get(opts, :stale, false)

      if Keyword.get(opts, :privacy_removed, false) and not stale?,
        do: Recipients.dispose_locked(current)

      persist(current, %{
        acknowledged: acknowledged,
        removal_completed: Keyword.get(opts, :removed, false) and not stale?,
        lease_token: nil,
        lease_until: nil,
        attempts: 0,
        retry_at: nil,
        failure: nil,
        failure_episode: nil,
        alerted_at: nil
      })

      if stale?, do: {:snooze, 1}, else: :ok
    end)
  end

  def release(event) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      persist(current, %{
        lease_token: nil,
        lease_until: nil,
        attempts: max(current.attempts - 1, 0)
      })

      :ok
    end)
  end

  def current?(event) do
    Repo.exists?(
      from(e in Event,
        where:
          e.id == ^event.id and e.revision == ^event.revision and
            e.lease_token == ^event.lease_token and e.generation == ^event.generation
      )
    )
  end

  def fail(event, reason, now) do
    now = timestamp(now)

    owned(event, &fail_current(&1, event, reason, now))
  end

  # A failed obsolete read cannot park a source correction committed while
  # this owner was working (notably a missing-end-time backfill).
  defp fail_current(%{revision: current_revision} = current, %{revision: revision}, _reason, _now)
       when current_revision != revision do
    persist(current, %{
      lease_token: nil,
      lease_until: nil,
      attempts: max(current.attempts - 1, 0)
    })

    {:retry, 1}
  end

  defp fail_current(current, _event, reason, now) do
    retry? = reason in [:transient, :conflict] and current.attempts < @max_attempts
    delay = min(30 * Integer.pow(2, min(current.attempts - 1, 6)), 1800)
    failure = if reason == :exhausted, do: "exhausted", else: to_string(reason)

    failed =
      persist(current, %{
        lease_token: nil,
        lease_until: nil,
        retry_at: if(retry?, do: DateTime.add(now, delay)),
        failure: failure,
        failure_episode: current.failure_episode || Ecto.UUID.generate()
      })

    if retry?, do: {:retry, delay}, else: {:failed, failed}
  end

  def owned(event, fun) do
    {:ok, result} =
      Repo.transaction(fn ->
        current = Repo.one!(from(e in Event, where: e.id == ^event.id, lock: "FOR UPDATE"))

        if current.lease_token == event.lease_token and current.generation == event.generation,
          do: fun.(current),
          else: {:skip, :superseded}
      end)

defmodule Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.Store do
  @moduledoc """
  Durable identity, intent and fenced ownership for organizer events.

  Source transactions lock source rows before this row. Reconciliation never
  locks a source row and never holds a transaction across Google I/O. A lease
  survives a crashed driver; every mutation also uses Google's event identity
  or ETag so an expired owner cannot blindly overwrite a newer provider state.
  """
  import Ecto.Query

  alias Dhc.Repo
  alias Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.{Event, Recipients}
  alias Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.Workers.SyncWorker

  @lease_seconds 120
  @max_attempts 6

  def record(kind, id, deleted) do
    unless Repo.in_transaction?(), do: raise("Calendar intent requires the source transaction")

    ensure(kind, id)

    from(e in Event, where: e.source_kind == ^to_string(kind) and e.source_id == ^id)
    |> Repo.update_all(
      inc: [revision: 1],
      set: [deleted: deleted, removal_completed: false, updated_at: DateTime.utc_now()]
    )

    # A source-owned schedule correction can resolve missing legacy data.
    # Do not re-arm provider/configuration failures on unrelated domain writes.
    from(e in Event,
      where:
        e.source_kind == ^to_string(kind) and e.source_id == ^id and
          e.failure in ["missing_end_time", "invalid_schedule"]
    )
    |> Repo.update_all(set: [failure: nil, attempts: 0, retry_at: nil])

    enqueue(kind, id)
    if find(kind, id, "participant"), do: enqueue_audience(kind, id, "participant")
    :ok
  end

  def ensure(kind, id, audience \\ "committee") do
    now = DateTime.utc_now()

    Repo.insert_all(
      Event,
      [
        %{
          id: Ecto.UUID.generate(),
          source_kind: to_string(kind),
          source_id: id,
          audience: to_string(audience),
          event_id: event_id(kind, id, audience, 0),
          inserted_at: now,
          updated_at: now
        }
      ],
      on_conflict: :nothing,
      conflict_target: [:source_kind, :source_id, :audience]
    )

    :ok
  end

  def enqueue(kind, id, delay \\ 0) do
    %{source_kind: to_string(kind), source_id: id}
    |> SyncWorker.new(schedule_in: delay)
    |> Oban.insert!()
  end

  def enqueue_audience(kind, id, audience, delay \\ 0) do
    %{source_kind: to_string(kind), source_id: id, audience: to_string(audience)}
    |> SyncWorker.new(schedule_in: delay)
    |> Oban.insert!()
  end

  def find(kind, id, audience) do
    Repo.get_by(Event, source_kind: to_string(kind), source_id: id, audience: to_string(audience))
  end

  def claim(kind, id, now, audience \\ "committee") do
    now = timestamp(now)

    {:ok, result} =
      Repo.transaction(fn ->
        event =
          Repo.one!(
            from(e in Event,
              where:
                e.source_kind == ^to_string(kind) and e.source_id == ^id and
                  e.audience == ^to_string(audience),
              lock: "FOR UPDATE"
            )
          )

        claim_available(event, now)
      end)

    result
  end

  defp claim_available(event, now) do
    cond do
      event.removal_completed ->
        {:skip, :removed}

      event.lease_until && DateTime.compare(event.lease_until, now) == :gt ->
        {:skip, :busy}

      event.failure && is_nil(event.retry_at) ->
        {:skip, :failed}

      event.retry_at && DateTime.compare(event.retry_at, now) == :gt ->
        {:skip, :backoff}

      true ->
        claimed =
          persist(event, %{
            lease_token: Ecto.UUID.generate(),
            lease_until: DateTime.add(now, @lease_seconds),
            attempts: event.attempts + 1
          })

        {:ok, claimed}
    end
  end

  def exhausted?(event), do: event.attempts > @max_attempts

  def bind_calendar(event, calendar_id) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      cond do
        is_nil(current.calendar_id) -> {:ok, persist(current, %{calendar_id: calendar_id})}
        current.calendar_id == calendar_id -> {:ok, current}
        true -> {:error, :configuration}
      end
    end)
  end

  # A deleted Google event may remain as a tombstone forever. Persist the new
  # generation before attempting insert, including on the first absent ack.
  def next_generation(event) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      generation = current.generation + 1

      {:ok,
       persist(current, %{
         generation: generation,
         event_id: event_id(current.source_kind, current.source_id, current.audience, generation),
         create_requested: false,
         acknowledged: nil
       })}
    end)
  end

  # Persist the possibility of an ambiguous create before starting HTTP, and
  # refuse a stale lease/revision even if the driver's old source view matches.
  def prepare_create(event) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      if current.revision == event.revision and not current.deleted do
        persist(current, %{create_requested: true})
        :ok
      else
        {:skip, :changed}
      end
    end)
  end

  def finish(event, acknowledged, _now, opts \\ []) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      stale? = current.revision != event.revision or Keyword.get(opts, :stale, false)

      if Keyword.get(opts, :privacy_removed, false) and not stale?,
        do: Recipients.dispose_locked(current)

      persist(current, %{
        acknowledged: acknowledged,
        removal_completed: Keyword.get(opts, :removed, false) and not stale?,
        lease_token: nil,
        lease_until: nil,
        attempts: 0,
        retry_at: nil,
        failure: nil,
        failure_episode: nil,
        alerted_at: nil
      })

      if stale?, do: {:snooze, 1}, else: :ok
    end)
  end

  def release(event) do
    owned(event, fn current ->
      persist(current, %{
        lease_token: nil,
        lease_until: nil,
        attempts: max(current.attempts - 1, 0)
      })

      :ok
    end)
  end

  def current?(event) do
    Repo.exists?(
      from(e in Event,
        where:
          e.id == ^event.id and e.revision == ^event.revision and
            e.lease_token == ^event.lease_token and e.generation == ^event.generation
      )
    )
  end

  def fail(event, reason, now) do
    now = timestamp(now)

    owned(event, &fail_current(&1, event, reason, now))
  end

  # A failed obsolete read cannot park a source correction committed while
  # this owner was working (notably a missing-end-time backfill).
  defp fail_current(%{revision: current_revision} = current, %{revision: revision}, _reason, _now)
       when current_revision != revision do
    persist(current, %{
      lease_token: nil,
      lease_until: nil,
      attempts: max(current.attempts - 1, 0)
    })

    {:retry, 1}
  end

  defp fail_current(current, _event, reason, now) do
    retry? = reason in [:transient, :conflict] and current.attempts < @max_attempts
    delay = min(30 * Integer.pow(2, min(current.attempts - 1, 6)), 1800)
    failure = if reason == :exhausted, do: "exhausted", else: to_string(reason)

    failed =
      persist(current, %{
        lease_token: nil,
        lease_until: nil,
        retry_at: if(retry?, do: DateTime.add(now, delay)),
        failure: failure,
        failure_episode: current.failure_episode || Ecto.UUID.generate()
      })

    if retry?, do: {:retry, delay}, else: {:failed, failed}
  end

  def owned(event, fun) do
    {:ok, result} =
      Repo.transaction(fn ->
        current = Repo.one!(from(e in Event, where: e.id == ^event.id, lock: "FOR UPDATE"))

        if current.lease_token == event.lease_token and current.generation == event.generation,
          do: fun.(current),
          else: {:skip, :superseded}
      end)
