defmodule Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.Roster do @moduledoc """ Participant-array reconciliation within the shared organizer-event protocol. Remove first, then add one entitlement at a time: a rejected address cannot strand another person's cancellation or poison every valid addition. Surviving Google attendee records (including RSVP) are never reconstructed. An accepted entitlement missing from the organizer copy is not invited again in the same event generation. A new place has its own entitlement. """ alias Dhc.WorkshopCalendar alias Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.{Google, Recipients} @content ~w(id summary location start end status visibility guestsCanInviteOthers guestsCanModify guestsCanSeeOtherGuests) @meaningful ~w(summary location start end) def validate_recipients(event) do event |> Recipients.list() |> Enum.filter(&(&1.active and is_nil(&1.failure))) |> Enum.each(fn recipient -> unless Recipients.valid?(recipient.recipient), do: Recipients.reject(event, recipient, :invalid_recipient) end) Recipients.alert_failures(event) end def required?(event, source) do Enum.any?(Recipients.list(event), &eligible?(&1, source)) end # Privacy is independent of today's source roster/schedule. Preserve every # unaffected Google guest and all historical content, even with source rows # gone or a legacy end time unknown. A shared address still belongs to its # surviving entitlement; disposing the deleted binding must not cancel it. def cleanup(_event, %{"attendeesOmitted" => true}, _allowed), do: {:error, :transient} def cleanup(event, observed, allowed) do recipients = Recipients.list(event) retiring = recipients |> Enum.filter(& &1.privacy_pending) |> Enum.flat_map(&[&1.recipient | &1.previous_recipients]) |> MapSet.new(&Recipients.address/1) retained = recipients |> Enum.filter(& &1.active) |> MapSet.new(&Recipients.address(&1.recipient)) removed = MapSet.difference(retiring, retained) attendees = Map.get(observed, "attendees", []) survivors = Enum.reject(attendees, &MapSet.member?(removed, Recipients.address(&1["email"]))) body = observed |> Map.take(@content) |> Map.put("attendees", survivors) updates = if attendees == survivors, do: "none", else: "all" # Even an absent guest needs a conditional write before disposing its # address: an expired owner may have an addition in flight with the old # ETag. Do not falsely acknowledge cleanup if Google kept that version. with {:ok, updated} <- write(event, observed, body, allowed, updates) do if updated["etag"] != observed["etag"] and is_binary(updated["etag"]), do: {:ok, Map.take(updated, @content)}, else: {:error, :conflict} end end def reconcile(event, source, observed, desired, clock, allowed) do if observed["attendeesOmitted"] == true do {:error, :transient} else recipients = Recipients.list(event) attendees = Map.get(observed, "attendees", []) with :ok <- Recipients.observed(event, attendees), {:ok, current} <- remove_and_repair(event, source, observed, desired, recipients, clock, allowed), :ok <- Recipients.observed(event, Map.get(current, "attendees", [])), {:ok, current} <- add_each(event, source, current, recipients, clock, allowed), :ok <- Recipients.observed(event, Map.get(current, "attendees", [])) do Recipients.alert_failures(event) # Attendee PII belongs only in retained bindings, not a second JSON copy. {:ok, Map.take(current, @content)} end end end defp remove_and_repair(event, source, observed, desired, recipients, clock, allowed) do wanted = recipients |> Enum.filter(&eligible?(&1, source)) |> MapSet.new(&Recipients.address(&1.recipient)) attendees = Map.get(observed, "attendees", []) retiring = retiring_addresses(event, source, recipients) survivors = Enum.filter(attendees, fn attendee -> address = Recipients.address(attendee["email"]) MapSet.member?(wanted, address) and not MapSet.member?(retiring, address) end) past? = WorkshopCalendar.ended?(source, clock) # Historical details stay as recorded. Only owed attendee removals run. body = if past?, do: Map.take(observed, @content), else: Map.delete(desired, "attendees") body = Map.put(body, "attendees", survivors) body = if not past? and observed["description"] not in [nil, ""], do: Map.put(body, "description", ""), else: body if matches?(observed, body) do {:ok, observed} else notify? = attendees != survivors or Enum.any?(@meaningful, &(not same?(&1, observed[&1], body[&1]))) write(event, observed, body, allowed, if(notify?, do: "all", else: "none")) end end defp retiring_addresses(event, source, recipients) do retiring = recipients |> Enum.filter(&(not &1.active and &1.removed_generation != event.generation)) |> MapSet.new(&Recipients.address(&1.recipient)) retiring = Enum.reduce(recipients, retiring, fn r, acc -> Enum.reduce(r.previous_recipients, acc, &MapSet.put(&2, Recipients.address(&1))) end) # A Google guest is shared when multiple logical places use one address. # Removing one entitlement must not reset the surviving place's RSVP. retained = recipients |> Enum.filter( &(eligible?(&1, source) and is_nil(&1.failure) and (&1.invited_generation == event.generation or &1.requested_generation == event.generation)) ) |> MapSet.new(&Recipients.address(&1.recipient)) MapSet.difference(retiring, retained) end defp add_each(event, source, observed, recipients, clock, allowed) do Enum.reduce_while(recipients, {:ok, observed}, fn recipient, {:ok, current} -> case add_one(event, source, current, recipient, clock, allowed) do {:ok, updated} -> {:cont, {:ok, updated}} other -> {:halt, other} end end) end defp add_one(event, source, current, recipient, clock, allowed) do if add?(recipient, source, current, event, clock) do invite_or_share(event, source, current, recipient, clock, allowed) else {:ok, current} end end defp invite_or_share(event, source, current, recipient, clock, allowed) do if Enum.any?( Map.get(current, "attendees", []), &(Recipients.address(&1["email"]) == Recipients.address(recipient.recipient)) ) do # The second place shares an already-present organizer guest. Record # its entitlement without notifying or reconstructing that guest. with :ok <- allowed.(), :ok <- Recipients.prepare_add(event, recipient), do: {:ok, current} else body = current |> Map.take(@content) |> Map.put( "attendees", Map.get(current, "attendees", []) ++ [%{"email" => recipient.recipient}] ) can_add = fn -> prepare_add_before_end(event, source, recipient, clock, allowed) end addition_result(write(event, current, body, can_add, "all"), event, recipient, current) end end defp prepare_add_before_end(event, source, recipient, clock, allowed) do if WorkshopCalendar.ended?(source, clock) do {:skip, :ended} else with :ok <- allowed.(), do: Recipients.prepare_add(event, recipient) end end defp addition_result({:error, :rejected}, event, recipient, current) do with :ok <- Recipients.reject(event, recipient, :rejected_recipient), do: {:ok, current} end defp addition_result(result, _event, _recipient, _current), do: result defp add?(recipient, source, _observed, event, clock) do eligible?(recipient, source) and is_nil(recipient.failure) and recipient.invited_generation != event.generation and not WorkshopCalendar.ended?(source, clock) end defp eligible?(recipient, source), do: recipient.active and recipient.place_id in source.place_ids and Recipients.valid?(recipient.recipient) defp write(event, observed, body, allowed, updates) do with :ok <- allowed.(), etag when is_binary(etag) <- observed["etag"] do Google.update(event.calendar_id, event.event_id, body, etag, audience: :participant, send_updates: updates, before_mutation: allowed ) else nil -> {:error, :transient} other -> other end end defp matches?(observed, desired), do: Enum.all?(desired, fn {key, value} -> same?(key, observed[key], value) end) defp same?(key, observed, desired) when key in ["start", "end"] do with %{"dateTime" => actual} <- observed, %{"dateTime" => expected} <- desired, {:ok, actual, _} <- DateTime.from_iso8601(actual), {:ok, expected, _} <- DateTime.from_iso8601(expected) do DateTime.compare(actual, expected) == :eq and observed["timeZone"] == desired["timeZone"] else _ -> false end end defp same?(_key, nil, []), do: true defp same?(_key, observed, desired), do: observed == desired end --- untracked projection test --- defmodule Dhc.Workshops.CalendarProjectionTest do use Dhc.DataCase, async: true alias Dhc.Repo alias Dhc.WorkshopFixtures alias Dhc.Workshops describe "calendar_projection/1" do test "returns only Calendar-safe Workshop fields, including archived sources" do workshop = WorkshopFixtures.workshop_fixture( title: "Calendar Workshop", description: "Do not expose this", location: "Main hall", status: "published" ) {:ok, _} = workshop |> Ecto.Changeset.change(archived_at: ~U[2026-11-04 10:00:00Z]) |> Repo.update() assert %{ id: id, title: "Calendar Workshop", status: "published", start_date: start_date, end_date: end_date, location: "Main hall" } = Workshops.calendar_projection(workshop.id) assert id == workshop.id assert %DateTime{} = start_date assert %DateTime{} = end_date assert Map.keys(Workshops.calendar_projection(workshop.id)) |> Enum.sort() == [:end_date, :id, :location, :start_date, :status, :title] assert Workshops.calendar_projection(Ecto.UUID.generate()) == nil end end describe "calendar_source_ids/1" do test "includes upcoming archived sources and cancelled historical sources" do now = ~U[2026-11-04 12:00:00Z] upcoming_archived = WorkshopFixtures.workshop_fixture( start_date: DateTime.add(now, 86_400, :second), end_date: DateTime.add(now, 93_600, :second), status: "published" ) {:ok, _} = upcoming_archived |> Ecto.Changeset.change(archived_at: now) |> Repo.update() cancelled_past =     %{data: %{workshop: calendar_workshop(workshop)}}

    %{

        action: result.action,

    %{data: %{workshops: Enum.map(workshops, &calendar_workshop/1)}}

    %{data: %{workshops: Enum.map(workshops, &workshop/1)}}
  end

  def render("management.json", %{workshop: workshop}) do
    %{data: %{workshop: calendar_workshop(workshop)}}
  end

  def render("interest.json", %{result: result}) do
    %{
      data: %{
        interested: result.interested,
        action: result.action,
        message: result.message
      }
    }
  end

  def render("registration_payment_intent.json", %{result: result}) do
    %{
      data: %{
        clientSecret: result.client_secret,
        paymentIntentId: result.payment_intent_id
      }
    }
  end

  def render("registration.json", %{registration: registration}) do
    %{data: %{registration: registration(registration)}}
  end

  def render("registration_cancelled.json", %{result: result}) do
    %{
      data: %{
        registration: registration(result.registration),
        refundPending: result.refund_pending
      }
    }
  end

  def render("external_registration_gate.json", %{gate: gate}) do
    data = %{canRegister: gate.can_register}

      if gate.can_register do

        Map.put(data, :reason, gate.reason)

        checkoutUrl: result.checkout_url

    %{data: %{refunds: Enum.map(refunds, &refund/1)}}

    %{data: %{refund: refund(refund)}}

  defp update_if_changed(event, source, observed, clock) do
    desired = desired_event(event, source)

    if matches?(observed, desired) do
      finish(event, desired, source, clock)
    else
      body =
        if Map.get(observed, "attendees", []) == [] and

           do: desired,

      with :ok <- mutation_allowed(event, source, clock),
           {:ok, etag} <- etag(observed),
           {:ok, _updated} <-
             Google.update(event.calendar_id, event.event_id, body, etag,
               before_mutation: fn -> mutation_allowed(event, source, clock) end
             ) do
        finish(event, desired, source, clock)
      end
    end
  end

  defp remove(event, source, observed, clock) do
    with :ok <- mutation_allowed(event, source, clock, true),
         {:ok, etag} <- etag(observed) do
      case Google.delete(event.calendar_id, event.event_id, etag,
             audience: audience(event),
             before_mutation: fn -> mutation_allowed(event, source, clock, true) end
           ) do

          finish(event, nil, source, clock, removed: true, privacy_removed: true)

        error ->
          error
      end
    end
  end

  defp matches?(observed, desired) do

defmodule Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.Google do
  @moduledoc """
   Google Calendar transport boundary for the two organizer calendars.

  Each operation exchanges the dedicated organizer refresh token for a
  short-lived access token, then makes exactly one Calendar API request. The
  boundary neither caches credentials nor retries: callers own retry and
  reconciliation. Provider responses and transport exceptions are deliberately
  collapsed into closed atoms so credentials and provider bodies never become
  logs, errors, or exception metadata.
  """

  @scope "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events.owned"
  @token_url "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
  @calendar_url "https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3"

  @type error ::
          :missing | :gone | :unauthorized | :configuration | :conflict | :transient | :rejected

  @doc "Gets an event from an organizer calendar."
  @spec get(String.t(), String.t()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()}
  def get(calendar_id, event_id) do
    with {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         {:ok, response} <- request(:get, event_path(calendar_id, event_id), token) do
      event_response(response)
    end
  end

  @doc "Checks that the organizer credential can read the configured calendar."
  @spec check_calendar(String.t()) :: :ok | {:error, error()}
  def check_calendar(calendar_id) do
    with {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         {:ok, response} <-
           request(:get, events_path(calendar_id), token, params: [maxResults: 1, fields: "kind"]) do
      calendar_check_response(response)
    end
  end

  @doc "Creates a committee-only event without notifying attendees."
  @spec insert(String.t(), map()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()} | term()
  @spec insert(String.t(), map(), keyword()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()} | term()
  def insert(calendar_id, event, opts \\ [])

  def insert(calendar_id, event, opts) when is_map(event) and is_list(opts) do
    with :ok <- audience_event(event, opts),
         {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         :ok <- before_mutation(opts),
         {:ok, response} <-
           request(:post, events_path(calendar_id), token,
             json: event,
             send_updates: updates(opts)
           ) do
      event_response(response)
    end
  end

  def insert(_calendar_id, _event, _opts), do: {:error, :rejected}

  @doc "Replaces an event only when its Google ETag still matches."
  @spec update(String.t(), String.t(), map(), String.t()) ::
          {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()} | term()
  @spec update(String.t(), String.t(), map(), String.t(), keyword()) ::
          {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()} | term()
  def update(calendar_id, event_id, event, etag, opts \\ [])

  def update(calendar_id, event_id, event, etag, opts)
      when is_map(event) and is_binary(etag) and is_list(opts) do
    with :ok <- audience_event(event, opts),
         {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         :ok <- before_mutation(opts),
         {:ok, response} <-
           request(:put, event_path(calendar_id, event_id), token,
             json: event,
             headers: [{"if-match", etag}],
             send_updates: updates(opts)
           ) do
      event_response(response)
    end
  end

  def update(_calendar_id, _event_id, _event, _etag, _opts), do: {:error, :rejected}

  @doc "Deletes an event only when its Google ETag still matches."
  @spec delete(String.t(), String.t(), String.t()) ::
          {:ok, map() | :deleted} | {:error, error()} | term()
  @spec delete(String.t(), String.t(), String.t(), keyword()) ::
          {:ok, map() | :deleted} | {:error, error()} | term()
  def delete(calendar_id, event_id, etag, opts \\ [])

  def delete(calendar_id, event_id, etag, opts) when is_binary(etag) and is_list(opts) do
    with {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         :ok <- before_mutation(opts),
         {:ok, response} <-
           request(:delete, event_path(calendar_id, event_id), token,
             headers: [{"if-match", etag}],
             send_updates: updates(opts)
           ) do
      case response do
        %Req.Response{status: status} when status in 200..299 -> {:ok, :deleted}
        response -> {:error, classify_calendar(response)}
      end
    end
  end

  def delete(_calendar_id, _event_id, _etag, _opts), do: {:error, :rejected}

  defp access_token do
    with {:ok, credentials} <- credentials(),
         {:ok, response} <- refresh(credentials) do
      token_response(response)
    end
  end

  defp credentials do
    config = Application.get_env(:dhc, Dhc.WorkshopCalendar, [])

    case {Keyword.get(config, :client_id), Keyword.get(config, :client_secret),
          Keyword.get(config, :refresh_token)} do
      {client_id, client_secret, refresh_token}
      when is_binary(client_id) and client_id != "" and is_binary(client_secret) and
             client_secret != "" and
             is_binary(refresh_token) and refresh_token != "" ->
        {:ok, {client_id, client_secret, refresh_token}}

      _missing ->
        {:error, :configuration}
    end
  end

  defp refresh({client_id, client_secret, refresh_token}) do
    request_options(
      method: :post,
      url: @token_url,
      form: [
        grant_type: "refresh_token",
        client_id: client_id,
        client_secret: client_secret,
        refresh_token: refresh_token,
        scope: @scope
      ]
    )
    |> Req.request()
    |> transport_safe()
  rescue
    _exception -> {:error, :transient}
  end

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{status: status, body: body}) when status in 200..299 do
    case body do
      %{"access_token" => token} when is_binary(token) and token != "" ->
      %{"access_token" => token} when is_binary(token) and token != "" ->
        if valid_scope?(Map.get(body, "scope")), do: {:ok, token}, else: {:error, :configuration}

      _invalid_body ->
        {:error, :configuration}
    end
  end

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{status: 400, body: %{"error" => "invalid_grant"}}),
    do: {:error, :unauthorized}

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{status: 401}), do: {:error, :unauthorized}

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status in 429..599,
    do: {:error, :transient}

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{}), do: {:error, :configuration}

  defp request(method, path, token, options \\ []) do
    headers = [{"authorization", "Bearer #{token}"} | Keyword.get(options, :headers, [])]
    send_updates = Keyword.get(options, :send_updates)

    options
    |> Keyword.drop([:headers, :send_updates])
    |> Keyword.merge(method: method, base_url: @calendar_url, url: path, headers: headers)
    |> maybe_send_updates(send_updates)
    |> request_options()
    |> Req.request()
    |> transport_safe()
  rescue
    _exception -> {:error, :transient}
  end

  defp event_response(%Req.Response{status: status, body: body})
       when status in 200..299 and is_map(body),
       do: {:ok, body}

  defp event_response(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status in 200..299,
    do: {:error, :rejected}

  defp event_response(response), do: {:error, classify_calendar(response)}

  defp calendar_check_response(%Req.Response{status: status, body: body})
       when status in 200..299 and is_map(body),
       do: :ok

  defp calendar_check_response(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status in 200..299,
    do: {:error, :rejected}

  defp calendar_check_response(response) do
    case classify_calendar(response) do
      reason when reason in [:missing, :gone] -> {:error, :configuration}
      reason -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: 401}), do: :unauthorized

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: 403, body: body}),
    do: if(rate_limited?(body), do: :transient, else: :configuration)

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: 404}), do: :missing
  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: 410}), do: :gone
  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status in [409, 412], do: :conflict

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status == 429 or status in 500..599,
    do: :transient

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{}), do: :rejected

  defp rate_limited?(%{"error" => %{"errors" => errors}}) when is_list(errors) do
    Enum.any?(errors, fn
      %{"reason" => reason} when reason in ["rateLimitExceeded", "userRateLimitExceeded"] -> true
      _error -> false
    end)
  end

  defp rate_limited?(_body), do: false

  defp valid_scope?(nil), do: true

  defp valid_scope?(scope) when is_binary(scope) do
    String.split(scope, " ", trim: true) == [@scope]
  end

  defp valid_scope?(_scope), do: false

  defp updates(opts) do
    if Keyword.get(opts, :audience) == :participant,
      do: Keyword.get(opts, :send_updates, "all"),
      else: "none"

defmodule Dhc.WorkshopCalendar.Google do
  @moduledoc """
   Google Calendar transport boundary for the two organizer calendars.

  Each operation exchanges the dedicated organizer refresh token for a
  short-lived access token, then makes exactly one Calendar API request. The
  boundary neither caches credentials nor retries: callers own retry and
  reconciliation. Provider responses and transport exceptions are deliberately
  collapsed into closed atoms so credentials and provider bodies never become
  logs, errors, or exception metadata.
  """

  @scope "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events.owned"
  @token_url "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
  @calendar_url "https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3"

  @type error ::
          :missing | :gone | :unauthorized | :configuration | :conflict | :transient | :rejected

  @doc "Gets an event from an organizer calendar."
  @spec get(String.t(), String.t()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()}
  def get(calendar_id, event_id) do
    with {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         {:ok, response} <- request(:get, event_path(calendar_id, event_id), token) do
      event_response(response)
    end
  end

  @doc "Checks that the organizer credential can read the configured calendar."
  @spec check_calendar(String.t()) :: :ok | {:error, error()}
  def check_calendar(calendar_id) do
    with {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         {:ok, response} <-
           request(:get, events_path(calendar_id), token, params: [maxResults: 1, fields: "kind"]) do
      calendar_check_response(response)
    end
  end

  @doc "Creates a committee-only event without notifying attendees."
  @spec insert(String.t(), map()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()} | term()
  @spec insert(String.t(), map(), keyword()) :: {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()} | term()
  def insert(calendar_id, event, opts \\ [])

  def insert(calendar_id, event, opts) when is_map(event) and is_list(opts) do
    with :ok <- audience_event(event, opts),
         {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         :ok <- before_mutation(opts),
         {:ok, response} <-
           request(:post, events_path(calendar_id), token,
             json: event,
             send_updates: updates(opts)
           ) do
      event_response(response)
    end
  end

  def insert(_calendar_id, _event, _opts), do: {:error, :rejected}

  @doc "Replaces an event only when its Google ETag still matches."
  @spec update(String.t(), String.t(), map(), String.t()) ::
          {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()} | term()
  @spec update(String.t(), String.t(), map(), String.t(), keyword()) ::
          {:ok, map()} | {:error, error()} | term()
  def update(calendar_id, event_id, event, etag, opts \\ [])

  def update(calendar_id, event_id, event, etag, opts)
      when is_map(event) and is_binary(etag) and is_list(opts) do
    with :ok <- audience_event(event, opts),
         {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         :ok <- before_mutation(opts),
         {:ok, response} <-
           request(:put, event_path(calendar_id, event_id), token,
             json: event,
             headers: [{"if-match", etag}],
             send_updates: updates(opts)
           ) do
      event_response(response)
    end
  end

  def update(_calendar_id, _event_id, _event, _etag, _opts), do: {:error, :rejected}

  @doc "Deletes an event only when its Google ETag still matches."
  @spec delete(String.t(), String.t(), String.t()) ::
          {:ok, map() | :deleted} | {:error, error()} | term()
  @spec delete(String.t(), String.t(), String.t(), keyword()) ::
          {:ok, map() | :deleted} | {:error, error()} | term()
  def delete(calendar_id, event_id, etag, opts \\ [])

  def delete(calendar_id, event_id, etag, opts) when is_binary(etag) and is_list(opts) do
    with {:ok, token} <- access_token(),
         :ok <- before_mutation(opts),
         {:ok, response} <-
           request(:delete, event_path(calendar_id, event_id), token,
             headers: [{"if-match", etag}],
             send_updates: updates(opts)
           ) do
      case response do
        %Req.Response{status: status} when status in 200..299 -> {:ok, :deleted}
        response -> {:error, classify_calendar(response)}
      end
    end
  end

  def delete(_calendar_id, _event_id, _etag, _opts), do: {:error, :rejected}

  defp access_token do
    with {:ok, credentials} <- credentials(),
         {:ok, response} <- refresh(credentials) do
      token_response(response)
    end
  end

  defp credentials do
    config = Application.get_env(:dhc, Dhc.WorkshopCalendar, [])

    case {Keyword.get(config, :client_id), Keyword.get(config, :client_secret),
          Keyword.get(config, :refresh_token)} do
      {client_id, client_secret, refresh_token}
      when is_binary(client_id) and client_id != "" and is_binary(client_secret) and
             client_secret != "" and
             is_binary(refresh_token) and refresh_token != "" ->
        {:ok, {client_id, client_secret, refresh_token}}

      _missing ->
        {:error, :configuration}
    end
  end

  defp refresh({client_id, client_secret, refresh_token}) do
    request_options(
      method: :post,
      url: @token_url,
      form: [
        grant_type: "refresh_token",
        client_id: client_id,
        client_secret: client_secret,
        refresh_token: refresh_token,
        scope: @scope
      ]
    )
    |> Req.request()
    |> transport_safe()
  rescue
    _exception -> {:error, :transient}
  end

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{status: status, body: body}) when status in 200..299 do
    case body do
      %{"access_token" => token} when is_binary(token) and token != "" ->
      %{"access_token" => token} when is_binary(token) and token != "" ->
        if valid_scope?(Map.get(body, "scope")), do: {:ok, token}, else: {:error, :configuration}

      _invalid_body ->
        {:error, :configuration}
    end
  end

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{status: 400, body: %{"error" => "invalid_grant"}}),
    do: {:error, :unauthorized}

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{status: 401}), do: {:error, :unauthorized}

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status in 429..599,
    do: {:error, :transient}

  defp token_response(%Req.Response{}), do: {:error, :configuration}

  defp request(method, path, token, options \\ []) do
    headers = [{"authorization", "Bearer #{token}"} | Keyword.get(options, :headers, [])]
    send_updates = Keyword.get(options, :send_updates)

    options
    |> Keyword.drop([:headers, :send_updates])
    |> Keyword.merge(method: method, base_url: @calendar_url, url: path, headers: headers)
    |> maybe_send_updates(send_updates)
    |> request_options()
    |> Req.request()
    |> transport_safe()
  rescue
    _exception -> {:error, :transient}
  end

  defp event_response(%Req.Response{status: status, body: body})
       when status in 200..299 and is_map(body),
       do: {:ok, body}

  defp event_response(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status in 200..299,
    do: {:error, :rejected}

  defp event_response(response), do: {:error, classify_calendar(response)}

  defp calendar_check_response(%Req.Response{status: status, body: body})
       when status in 200..299 and is_map(body),
       do: :ok

  defp calendar_check_response(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status in 200..299,
    do: {:error, :rejected}

  defp calendar_check_response(response) do
    case classify_calendar(response) do
      reason when reason in [:missing, :gone] -> {:error, :configuration}
      reason -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: 401}), do: :unauthorized

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: 403, body: body}),
    do: if(rate_limited?(body), do: :transient, else: :configuration)

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: 404}), do: :missing
  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: 410}), do: :gone
  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status in [409, 412], do: :conflict

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{status: status}) when status == 429 or status in 500..599,
    do: :transient

  defp classify_calendar(%Req.Response{}), do: :rejected

  defp rate_limited?(%{"error" => %{"errors" => errors}}) when is_list(errors) do
    Enum.any?(errors, fn
      %{"reason" => reason} when reason in ["rateLimitExceeded", "userRateLimitExceeded"] -> true
      _error -> false
    end)
  end

  defp rate_limited?(_body), do: false

  defp valid_scope?(nil), do: true

  defp valid_scope?(scope) when is_binary(scope) do
    String.split(scope, " ", trim: true) == [@scope]
  end

  defp valid_scope?(_scope), do: false

  defp updates(opts) do
    if Keyword.get(opts, :audience) == :participant,
      do: Keyword.get(opts, :send_updates, "all"),
      else: "none"

content.text: **Inspecting participant event handling**
**Verifying Maps URL validation logic**
**Confirming no generated client diff**
**Identifying no-op update affecting Calendar intent**
**Reviewing calendar sync and test coverage gaps**
**Noting test gap on participant updates**
**Verifying test coverage and source tracking**

## Finding

- **Missing participant-update coverage (acceptance gap).** ALE-440 requires a destination change to use normal participant Calendar updates and assert notification parameters. The new update test only syncs the **committee** event and asserts `sendUpdates=none` (`apps/phoenix/test/dhc/workshop_calendar/sync_test.exs:157-179`). The participant test creates a destination-bearing event then proves a repeat sync is a no-op, but never changes the destination or asserts `sendUpdates=all` (`apps/phoenix/test/dhc/workshop_calendar/participant_workshops_test.exs:164-208`). Add a real source update after a confirmed place and assert both audiences’ new location, retained RSVP/event identity, participant `sendUpdates=all`, committee `none`, then silence on repeat.

No other clear correctness or scope issues found in the `but diff` (including untracked files).

Verified: `pnpm check` passed (24 pre-existing Svelte warnings). Phoenix focused tests could not start because Docker is unavailable (`docker_socket_not_found`).
